name: Metamagic Rod, Murky
body:
Aura (no school) CL 5th; Slot none; Price 1,500 gp (lesser), 5,500 gp (normal), 12,250 gp (greater); Weight —

DESCRIPTION

The wielder of this rod can transform mist and fog spells into murky sediment underwater up to three times per day as though using the Murky Spell feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells freedom of movement; Cost 750 gp (lesser), 2,750 gp (normal), 6,125 gp (greater)
